study: round 5, vortexexam (track 2): exam pilot on the fed-vortex world

value.H_rule: largest size with >= 100.0 member-ticks/s (444 at B=1024)

throughput.note: member-ticks per second, float64 world with the vortex tracker, jax.vmap batch B; one tick = 250 native steps = 5 time units

law.note: x(t+16) - x(t) = b1 x(1-x) + b2 (1-2x) + e per eps, pooled over members and ticks >= 64; b1_line: weighted straight line b1 = c0 + c1 eps over the eps values; b1_proportional: b1 = c eps; b1_line_eps_positive: the line fitted without eps = 0 (chi2 against the member-bootstrap SEs)

scan.source: results/analysis1.json scan (analyse1.py on job r5-vortexexam-002: scan_main.npz, no branch file)
scan.note: headroom = theta-plug-in deficit / D_h of the null setting; L2 = mean over h 8, 16, 32 ticks of level 2 (N, s_b); L1 = mean over h 1, 2, 4, 8 of the block raster of the vortex list; L2_se, L1_se = SE over the (member, anchor) states of the setting; viability entries: [viable members, of, mean N, min N, max N]; paired_shift_z_main_runs: paired z of trajectory statistics against the null setting (z of N at ticks 100 on and of s_b at ticks 250 on, lo and hi edge; max |z| over 9 statistics)

viability.rule: fields finite, no tracker overflow, n_min <= N <= K - 1 at every state from t_from on

selection.basis: proxy: max |paired z| of N, s_b early, s_b late over the main runs (no branches)
selection.why: d = 4 because the measured throughput (444 member-ticks/s at 128^2) allows a 768-1024 point design; eps, nu and e are the rule's choice on the main-run proxy (selection, flow, fuel); mut128 is added instead of the next family by the proxy (growth: k) because it sets the mutation constant of the level-2 law, which is the study's question

value.mutation: mut128 = time between mutation events per 128 x 128 px of box (declared per unit area); at 128 x 128 px the interval is mut128 x 1

status_job2.source: results/analysis2.json (analyse2.py on origin/gpu-jobs:jobs/r5-vortexexam-003/out: scores.npz, items.npz, design*.npz) status
status_job2.note: job2 exits 0 even if its report stage fails (the Mac's review, point 5): prediction_final and report_failures_in_progress_txt are the check

ladder.source: results/analysis2.json (analyse2.py on origin/gpu-jobs:jobs/r5-vortexexam-003/out: scores.npz, items.npz, design*.npz) ladder
ladder.note: L = fair energy score pooled over items and the primary cells (level 2 jointly at h = 8, 16, 32 ticks); skill = (L(K) - L) / (L(K) - L(O)); families net / ridge / law / lin2; D, S, S2 by Lab episodes

gaps_by_truth.source: results/analysis2.json (analyse2.py on origin/gpu-jobs:jobs/r5-vortexexam-003/out: scores.npz, items.npz, design*.npz) gaps_L_by_truth
gaps_by_truth.note: dL = L(first) - L(second), pooled over the primary cells; positive = the second is better; se_truths = sd over truths of the per-truth mean / sqrt(n_truths)

acceptance_variants.source: results/analysis2.json (analyse2.py on origin/gpu-jobs:jobs/r5-vortexexam-003/out: scores.npz, items.npz, design*.npz) acceptance.rows
acceptance_variants.note: rows 'family@n|K reference|cells'; sigma = (L(null) - L(C)) / (L(K) - L(C)), null = the better of D@n and P0; rho = (L(P0) - L(S@n)) / (L(P0) - L(C)); SE and 5-95% range from the bootstrap clustered by truth; L per cell (mean over the cells used)

acceptance_best_over_families.source: results/analysis2.json (analyse2.py on origin/gpu-jobs:jobs/r5-vortexexam-003/out: scores.npz, items.npz, design*.npz) acceptance.best_over_families
acceptance_best_over_families.note: a sensitivity outside the roadmap's one-family rule: the best null (any D@n or P0), the best C (any C or Cded) and the best S over the four families

theory_T.source: results/analysis2.json (analyse2.py on origin/gpu-jobs:jobs/r5-vortexexam-003/out: scores.npz, items.npz, design*.npz) theory_T
theory_T.note: T = the replicator-mutator law for s_b and linear relaxation for N with constants fitted to the first n Lab episodes (vxnet.fit_law); it never runs level 0

value.note: reached = (V_change - Ve) / (V_change - Vu), Ve = mean squared error of the predictive mean; se = bootstrap over truths; rows = horizons, columns = (N, s_b)

cchg_by_truth.source: results/analysis2.json (analyse2.py on origin/gpu-jobs:jobs/r5-vortexexam-003/out: scores.npz, items.npz, design*.npz) cchg
cchg_by_truth.note: reached = (V_change - Ve) / (V_change - Vu), Ve = mean squared error of the predictive mean; se = bootstrap over truths; rows = horizons, columns = (N, s_b)

per_theta_b1.note: b1 fitted per design point from its own episodes (noisy), then regressed on theta

value.note: d s_b over h ticks = (b1_0 + sum_i b1_i u_i) s (1 - s) + (b2_0 + sum_i b2_i u_i) (1 - 2 s); u in box units [-1, 1]; design episodes carry the public program mix; states from the given tick on

law_design.source: results/analysis2.json (analyse2.py on origin/gpu-jobs:jobs/r5-vortexexam-003/out: scores.npz, items.npz, design*.npz) law_design
law_design.note: d s_b over h ticks = (b1_0 + sum_i b1_i u_i) s (1 - s) + (b2_0 + sum_i b2_i u_i) (1 - 2 s); u in box units [-1, 1]; design episodes carry the public program mix; states from the given tick on

value.note: contraction = posterior sd / prior sd per parameter (mean over truths); L1 = from level-1 summaries, L2 = from (N, s_b) only; in90 = share of (truth, parameter) pairs inside the central 90% interval

identification_digest.source: results/analysis2.json (analyse2.py on origin/gpu-jobs:jobs/r5-vortexexam-003/out: scores.npz, items.npz, design*.npz) identification
